name: merkle
description: Merkle hash tree over the spec: leaf hashes, interior hashes, snapshots, diff, and impact classification.

requirements.title: Compute leaf hashes
requirements.description: Hash each markdown content file and each JSON file in the spec. Leaf nodes in the merkle tree.

requirements.title: Compute interior hashes
requirements.description: Interior node hashes are computed from the sorted concatenation of their children's hashes. Tree mirrors spec hierarchy: project → module → {arch, impl} → leaves.

requirements.title: Store snapshots
requirements.description: Write the complete hash tree to a snapshot file committed to git alongside the spec.

requirements.title: Diff against snapshot
requirements.description: Compare current hash tree against a stored snapshot. Report changed leaves and changed paths (interior nodes whose hash changed).

requirements.title: Classify impact
requirements.description: Classify each change by its impact level: impl_only (only impl_section or test_section leaves changed), contract (data_flow leaves changed — a cross-component contract within the module), arch_impl (component leaves changed), or structural (module.json or project.json meta leaves changed, or requirement leaves changed). The contract level sits between arch_impl and structural: data_flow changes are not purely local like impl_section, nor do they rewire graph topology like component or meta changes — they alter the shapes moving between components and must reach the downstream action classifier so a dedicated data_flow task bead is created.

requirements.title: Deterministic hashing
requirements.description: Same file content always produces the same hash. Hash computation is order-independent for interior nodes (children sorted before hashing).

requirements.title: Identity-hash tree keying
requirements.description: Tree nodes are keyed by the spec node's identity hash (the same 12-character hex string stored in the JSON `id` field). The merkle key for a component, requirement, impl_section, data_flow, test_section, or api is exactly its identity hash — no nested module/type/id path. The keys for synthetic meta leaves use a fixed prefix plus the parent's identity hash (e.g., `meta/<module-hash>` for module.json, `meta/project` for project.json). This makes merkle keys identical to mapping-store `spec_node_id` values, eliminating the rekeying layer that previously translated between the two formats. Renaming a file or moving a directory with the same identity hash is detected as a modification, not a delete + add.

requirements.title: Change completeness validation
requirements.description: When individual requirement leaf nodes change in the diff (added, modified, or removed), verify that implementing components' content leaves also changed. For modified/added requirements, each implementing component's content leaf must also appear in the diff. For removed requirements, no component may still reference them. For project-level requirement changes, the chain must propagate through module requirements to component leaves. Errors are included alongside changes in the diff JSON output.

components.name: Hasher
components.description: Computes SHA-256 hashes for individual files (leaf nodes) and for sorted child hash lists (interior nodes).

components.name: TreeBuilder
components.description: Builds the merkle tree from the parsed spec graph. Each node's key is its spec identity hash (the 12-char hex `id` field) — no path-style keying, no module/type prefix. Requirements are individual leaf nodes with hashes computed from deterministic JSON serialization. Maps spec hierarchy to tree nodes.

components.name: SnapshotStore
components.description: Reads and writes snapshot files. Serializes the identity-hash-keyed tree to a JSON file for git storage. The flat map is keyed by identity hash (hash → {hash, type, ...}), not by file path or integer ID.

components.name: DiffEngine
components.description: Compares two identity-hash-keyed trees (current vs snapshot). Same identity hash + different content hash = modified. Identity hash in current but not snapshot = added. Identity hash in snapshot but not current = removed.

components.name: ImpactClassifier
components.description: Analyzes diff results to classify changes by their impact level: impl_only (impl_section, test_section), contract (data_flow), arch_impl (component), or structural (module.json, project.json, requirement). The contract level is distinct from impl_only because data_flow changes describe cross-component shapes — downstream matchers must not skip them. Uses node metadata (type, module association) instead of parsing path prefixes.

components.name: DiffCommand
components.description: CLI entry point for spex diff. Compares current merkle tree against stored snapshot via DiffEngine, classifies impact via ImpactClassifier, runs change completeness validation via CompletenessChecker. Outputs changes and errors in JSON or human-readable format.

components.name: CompletenessChecker
components.description: Validates that requirement leaf changes are accompanied by corresponding component content leaf changes. Reads the current spec graph (project.json, module.json) to resolve requirement-to-component edges via implements arrays. Checks added, modified, and removed requirements for completeness. Also validates component edge changes when meta nodes change without requirement leaf changes.

data_flows.name: Hash computation flow
data_flows.description: Spec files are hashed bottom-up: leaf files → interior nodes → tree root. The tree is then serialized to a snapshot.

data_flows.name: Diff and classification flow
data_flows.description: Current tree and stored snapshot are compared node-by-node. Changed paths are classified by impact level.

apis.name: spex diff
apis.description: Compute changes between snapshot and current spec
